top_call_exchanges.topic: Workers AI Monetization & Inference Cluster Utilization
top_call_exchanges.question: Can you unpack the inflection in revenue growth to 39% YoY? How much of that is direct Workers AI inference spend versus legacy web security and CDN re-acceleration?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Matthew Prince (CEO): 'Workers AI is the fastest-growing developer service in Cloudflare history. We now have over 3 million developers on Workers. Customers aren't just caching; they are executing real-time serverless AI inferences in 330 cities. Over 30% of Fortune 500 accounts are actively utilizing Cloudflare AI gateway services.'

top_call_exchanges.question: CapEx jumped to $121.8M this quarter compared to ~$61M in Q2. How should we think about capital intensity in Q4 and into 2027 as you build out GPU capacity?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Thomas Seifert (CFO): 'We accelerated GPU cluster installations into our server racks to meet surging demand. Because we co-locate inference silicon directly into existing connectivity nodes, our capital efficiency remains 3x higher than hyperscalers. CapEx as a percentage of revenue will normalize around 12-14% over time.'

top_call_exchanges.question: Zero Trust and SASE growth accelerated over 60% YoY. Are you seeing larger displacements of incumbent hardware firewalls and traditional VPN vendors?
top_call_exchanges.management_answer: Matthew Prince: 'Yes. In Q3 we closed our largest single SASE deal ever, replacing three legacy firewall vendors at a global financial institution. CIOs want a single pane of glass for security, connectivity, and developer edge.'
